mapper.select: SELECT subject_id,name subjectName,code subjectCode,CONCAT(code,' ',full_name) subjectNameBy from book_subject where is_auxiliary = TRUE and book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT ba.auxiliary_id,ba.code auxiliaryCode,ba.name auxiliaryName FROM book_voucher_record bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv ON bvr.voucher_id = bv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.customer_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.project_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.department_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.person_id
LEFT JOIN book_auxiliary ba ON ba.auxiliary_id = bvr.stock_id
where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%') and bv.year_period >= #{startPeriod} and bv.year_period <= #{endPeriod}
and ba.auxiliary_id = #{auxiliaryId}
group by ba.auxiliary_id
